description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack Stage 2 to cast Rending Lunge.

Rending Lunge

Deal Havoc DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast Death Snip.
Use Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill in mid-air to cast Hanging Finality.

Death Snip

Open the scissors, dealing Havoc DMG. After a while, the scissors snip, dealing Havoc DMG and restoring HP for all nearby Resonators in the team.
Use Normal Attack during this skill to deal additional Havoc DMG. Use Normal Attack again to immediately snip the target.
The skill DMG is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Death Snip to cast Thread Withdrawn.

Thread Withdrawn

Deal Havoc DMG.
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after being cast.

Heavy Attack

Leap into the air and consume STA to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
This skill cannot be cast while in Chainsaw Mode.
Perform the following actions within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Hanging Finality:
- Press Normal Attack;
- Cast Lifethread - Glide and press Normal Attack before landing.
Hold Normal Attack before landing after casting Heavy Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Severed Facet.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.
While not in Chainsaw Mode, press Normal Attack within a certain time after casting Mid-air Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Severed Facet

Deal Havoc DMG.
Use Normal Attack within a certain time after casting Heavy Attack - Severed Facet to cast Hanging Finality.
If interrupted, Heavy Attack - Severed Facet can be cast again by holding Normal Attack before landing. This effect can be triggered once only before landing.

Hanging Finality

Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast Death Snip.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Rending Lunge.

Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction

Hold Dodge after a successful Dodge on the ground to cast Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction to attack and Stagnate the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
- While not in Chainsaw Mode, after casting this skill, Press Normal Attack on the ground or use Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Rending Lunge. This effect is removed when Chisa enters Chainsaw Mode.
- While in Chainsaw Mode, press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 2 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Havoc DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2 untuk melancarkan Rending Lunge.

Rending Lunge

Memberikan Havoc DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini di darat untuk melancarkan Death Snip.
Gunakan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini di udara untuk melancarkan Hanging Finality.

Death Snip

Membuka gunting, memberikan Havoc DMG. Setelah beberapa saat, gunting menjepit, memberikan Havoc DMG dan memulihkan HP seluruh Resonator di sekitar dalam tim.
Gunakan Normal Attack selama skill ini untuk memberikan tambahan Havoc DMG. Gunakan Normal Attack lagi untuk langsung menjepit target.
DMG skill ini dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan Death Snip untuk melancarkan Thread Withdrawn.

Thread Withdrawn

Memberikan Havoc DMG.
Dapat memicu Dodge berhasil dalam jangka waktu tertentu setelah dilancarkan.

Heavy Attack

Melompat ke udara dan mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.
Skill ini tidak dapat dilancarkan saat dalam Chainsaw Mode.
Lakukan tindakan berikut dalam jangka waktu tertentu setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Hanging Finality:
- Tekan Normal Attack;
- Lancarkan Lifethread - Glide dan tekan Normal Attack sebelum mendarat.
Tahan Normal Attack sebelum mendarat setelah melancarkan Heavy Attack untuk melancarkan Heavy Attack - Severed Facet.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Havoc DMG.
Saat tidak dalam Chainsaw Mode, tekan Normal Attack dalam jangka waktu tertentu setelah melancarkan Mid-air Attack untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2.

Heavy Attack - Severed Facet

Memberikan Havoc DMG.
Gunakan Normal Attack dalam jangka waktu tertentu setelah melancarkan Heavy Attack - Severed Facet untuk melancarkan Hanging Finality.
Jika diinterupsi, Heavy Attack - Severed Facet dapat dilancarkan lagi dengan menahan Normal Attack sebelum mendarat. Efek ini hanya dapat terpicu sekali sebelum mendarat.

Hanging Finality

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Havoc DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini di darat untuk melancarkan Death Snip.

Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Rending Lunge.

Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction

Tahan Dodge setelah Dodge berhasil di darat untuk melancarkan Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction guna menyerang dan menahan target (Stagnation), memberikan Havoc DMG.
- Saat tidak dalam Chainsaw Mode, setelah melancarkan skill ini, tekan Normal Attack di darat atau gunakan Normal Attack di udara untuk melancarkan Rending Lunge. Efek ini dihapus saat Chisa memasuki Chainsaw Mode.
- Saat dalam Chainsaw Mode, tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Sawring - Blitz Tahap 3.

description.en:
Eye of Unraveling

Stagnate and deal Havoc DMG.
- While not in Chainsaw Mode, after casting this skill, press Normal Attack on the ground or use Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Rending Lunge. This effect is removed when Chisa enters Chainsaw Mode.
- While in Chainsaw Mode and on the ground, press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Serrated Loop

While on the ground and Ring of Chainsaw is full, Resonance Skill is replaced with Serrated Loop.
Stagnate targets, and deal Havoc DMG and pull in nearby targets.
Casting this skill sends Chisa into Chainsaw Mode and replaces Resonance Skill with Eye of Unraveling.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2.
Hold Resonance Skill while casting this skill to continuously attack and pull in nearby targets. Release the Resonance Skill button in the duration or keep holding it for a certain period of time to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 1.
description.id:
Eye of Unraveling

Menahan target (Stagnation) dan memberikan Havoc DMG.
- Saat tidak dalam Chainsaw Mode, setelah melancarkan skill ini, tekan Normal Attack di darat atau gunakan Normal Attack di udara untuk melancarkan Rending Lunge. Efek ini dihapus saat Chisa memasuki Chainsaw Mode.
- Saat dalam Chainsaw Mode dan di darat, tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Sawring - Blitz Tahap 2.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

Serrated Loop

Saat di darat dan Ring of Chainsaw penuh, Resonance Skill diganti dengan Serrated Loop.
Menahan target (Stagnation), memberikan Havoc DMG, dan menarik target di sekitar.
Melancarkan skill ini membawa Chisa ke Chainsaw Mode dan mengganti Resonance Skill dengan Eye of Unraveling.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Sawring - Blitz Tahap 2.
Tahan Resonance Skill saat melancarkan skill ini untuk terus menyerang dan menarik target di sekitar. Lepas tombol Resonance Skill selama durasi atau terus tahan selama jangka waktu tertentu untuk melancarkan Sawring - Blitz Tahap 1.

description.en:
Deal Havoc DMG and recover HP for all nearby Resonators in the team.
Casting this skill sends Chisa into Woven Myriad - Convergence for 15s.
While not in Chainsaw Mode, press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Woven Myriad - Convergence

The DMG Multipliers of Sawring - Blitz, Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter, and Sawring - Eradication are increased by 120%.
The bonus DMG Multiplier for Sawring - Eradication granted by Sawring- Blitz and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter when Ring of Chainsaw is consumed additionally increases by 120%.
Casting Sawring - Eradication ends Woven Myriad - Convergence.
description.id:
Memberikan Havoc DMG dan memulihkan HP seluruh Resonator di sekitar dalam tim.
Melancarkan skill ini membawa Chisa ke Woven Myriad - Convergence selama 15 dtk.
Saat tidak dalam Chainsaw Mode, tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara dekat tanah.

Woven Myriad - Convergence

Pengali DMG Sawring - Blitz, Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter, dan Sawring - Eradication meningkat sebesar 120%.
Bonus Pengali DMG untuk Sawring - Eradication yang diberikan oleh Sawring- Blitz dan Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter saat Ring of Chainsaw dikonsumsi meningkat tambahan sebesar 120%.
Melancarkan Sawring - Eradication mengakhiri Woven Myriad - Convergence.

description.en: When a Resonator in the team defeats a target marked by Unseen Snare, the Cooldown of Chisa's Resonance Skill Eye of Unraveling is reset, triggered up to once every 3s.
description.id: Saat Resonator di tim mengalahkan target yang ditandai oleh Unseen Snare, Cooldown Resonance Skill Eye of Unraveling Chisa diatur ulang, dapat terpicu paling banyak sekali setiap 3 dtk.

description.en:
Casting Intro Skill Reverberance - Return or Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility grants 20% Havoc DMG Bonus and 20% Healing Bonus for 12s.
When Resonators in the team with Thread of Bane defeat a target marked by Unseen Snare, Chisa gains Sight of Unraveling, lasting 3s.
While in Sight of Unraveling, Chisa inflicts Unseen Snare that lasts for 30s on the targets damaged by Resonators in the team with Thread of Bane.
description.id:
Melancarkan Intro Skill Reverberance - Return atau Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility memberikan 20% Havoc DMG Bonus dan 20% Healing Bonus selama 12 dtk.
Saat Resonator di tim dengan Thread of Bane mengalahkan target yang ditandai oleh Unseen Snare, Chisa mendapat Sight of Unraveling, bertahan selama 3 dtk.
Saat dalam Sight of Unraveling, Chisa memberikan Unseen Snare yang bertahan selama 30 dtk pada target yang menerima damage dari Resonator di tim dengan Thread of Bane.

description.en:
Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
While not in Chainsaw Mode, press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
While in Chainsaw Mode, use Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2.
description.id:
Menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.
Saat tidak dalam Chainsaw Mode, tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2.
Saat dalam Chainsaw Mode, gunakan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Sawring - Blitz Tahap 2.

description.en:
Unseen Snare

Chisa inflicts Unseen Snare on the target for 30s in the following 4 ways:
- Hitting a target with Resonance Skill.
- Hitting a target within a certain period of time after casting Serrated Loop.
- Hitting a target with Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction.
- Locking on to a target.
When targets marked by Unseen Snare take direct damage from Resonators, Chisa inflicts 1 stacks of Havoc Bane on them. This effect can be triggered up to once every 2s.

Thread of Bane

When dealing damage to targets affected by Unseen Snare, ignore 18% of their DEF.

Chainsaw Mode

While in Chainsaw Mode, Chisa unlocks Sawring - Blitz, Sawring - Eradication, Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter.
Sawring - Blitz and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter consume Ring of Chainsaw on hit.

Sawring - Blitz

Sawring - Blitz chains up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.
Press Normal Attack to start the combo from Sawring - Blitz Stage 1. Hold Normal Attack to start from Sawring - Blitz Stage 2.
Hold Normal Attack while casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 2 to continuously attack the target. Sawring - Blitz Stage 2 is automatically followed by Sawring - Blitz Stage 3.
While casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 2, release the Normal Attack button or Dodge without directional input to automatically cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance, dealing Havoc DMG. Shortly after casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance, successful Dodges can be triggered.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3.
While casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 3, hold Normal Attack to continuously attack the target. Sawring - Blitz Stage 3 is automatically followed by Sawring - Eradication.
Release Normal Attack during Sawring - Blitz Stage 3 to automatically cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone, dealing Havoc DMG.
Sawring - Blitz DMG is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.

Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter

While in Chainsaw Mode, press Normal Attack following a successful Dodge to cast Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter, dealing Havoc DMG.
Press Normal Attack following Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3.
Hold Normal Attack while casting Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter to sustain the attack. When Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter ends, cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3 automatically.
Release the Normal Attack button or Dodge without directional input while casting Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance automatically.
Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter deals Resonance Liberation DMG.

Sawring - Eradication

While in Chainsaw Mode, Chisa casts Sawring - Eradication in the following 2 ways:
- Press Normal Attack after casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone.
- Press Normal Attack after consuming all Ring of Chainsaw with Sawring - Blitz or Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter.
Attacking targets with Sawring - Eradication deals Havoc DMG and grants Shields to all nearby Resonators in the team for 30s.
The skill DMG is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Every 1 point of Ring of Chainsaw consumed by Sawring - Blitz and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter increases the DMG Multiplier of the next Sawring - Eradication. Up to 100 points will be counted toward this effect.
Casting this skill consumes all Ring of Chainsaw and ends Chainsaw Mode.

Chainsaw Fever

While in Chainsaw Mode, Lifethread - Jetstream is replaced with Chainsaw Fever.
Chainsaw Fever is at 100% by default.
When Chisa goes on for a period without dealing any damage, Chainsaw Fever will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa enters the Burnout State and exits Chainsaw Mode.
While in Chainsaw Mode, Chisa resets Chainsaw Fever when dealing damage or when casting Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility, Intro Skill Reverberance - Return and Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone.
While in the Burnout State, Ring of Chainsaw will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa exits the Burnout State.
When in Burnout State, Chisa exits the state upon dealing damage, or casting Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility and Intro Skill Reverberance - Return.

Lifethread - Glide

When Chisa is not in Chainsaw Mode and has more than 10 points of Lifethread - Jetstream, she can consume 50 points of Lifethread - Jetstream to cast Lifethread - Glide in the following 5 ways:
- Press Dodge in mid-air before landing after casting Heavy Attack.
- While in mid-air, press Dodge before landing after casting Resonance Skill Eye of Unraveling or Rending Lunge.
- Dodge forward shortly after casting Thread Withdrawn.
- Press Dodge before landing when launched into mid-air.
- Press Dodge before landing after casting Lifethread - Glide.
Casting this skill can pull in nearby enemies marked by Unseen Snare.
During the skill, hold Dodge to glide a short distance on the weapon.
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after casting this skill.

Ring of Chainsaw

Chisa can hold up to 100 points of Ring of Chainsaw.
Hitting a target with Normal Attack and Resonance Skill Eye of Unraveling grants Ring of Chainsaw.
Casting Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility grants 40 points of Ring of Chainsaw.
Casting Intro Skill Reverberance - Return grants 20 points of Ring of Chainsaw.

Lifethread - Jetstream

Chisa can hold up to 100 points of Lifethread - Jetstream.
Chisa continuously obtains Lifethread - Jetstream over time.
Chisa obtains 100 points of Lifethread - Jetstream upon defeating a target.
Exiting Chainsaw Mode resets Lifethread - Jetstream to the max limit.
Chisa cannot obtain Lifethread - Jetstream passively for a short period of time after casting Lifethread - Glide.
description.id:
Unseen Snare

Chisa memberikan Unseen Snare pada target selama 30 dtk dengan 4 cara berikut:
- Mengenai target dengan Resonance Skill.
- Mengenai target dalam jangka waktu tertentu setelah melancarkan Serrated Loop.
- Mengenai target dengan Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction.
- Mengunci target.
Saat target yang ditandai oleh Unseen Snare menerima damage langsung dari Resonator, Chisa memberikan 1 stack Havoc Bane pada mereka. Efek ini dapat terpicu paling banyak sekali setiap 2 dtk.

Thread of Bane

Saat memberikan damage ke target yang terkena Unseen Snare, abaikan 18% DEF mereka.

Chainsaw Mode

Saat dalam Chainsaw Mode, Chisa membuka Sawring - Blitz, Sawring - Eradication, Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter.
Sawring - Blitz dan Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter mengonsumsi Ring of Chainsaw saat mengenai target.

Sawring - Blitz

Sawring - Blitz merangkai hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Havoc DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack untuk memulai kombo dari Sawring - Blitz Tahap 1. Tahan Normal Attack untuk memulai dari Sawring - Blitz Tahap 2.
Tahan Normal Attack saat melancarkan Sawring - Blitz Tahap 2 untuk terus menyerang target. Sawring - Blitz Tahap 2 otomatis dilanjutkan dengan Sawring - Blitz Tahap 3.
Saat melancarkan Sawring - Blitz Tahap 2, lepas tombol Normal Attack atau Dodge tanpa input arah untuk otomatis melancarkan Sawring - Blitz Tahap 2: Discordance, memberikan Havoc DMG. Sesaat setelah melancarkan Sawring - Blitz Tahap 2: Discordance, Dodge berhasil dapat terpicu.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan Sawring - Blitz Tahap 2: Discordance untuk melancarkan Sawring - Blitz Tahap 3.
Saat melancarkan Sawring - Blitz Tahap 3, tahan Normal Attack untuk terus menyerang target. Sawring - Blitz Tahap 3 otomatis dilanjutkan dengan Sawring - Eradication.
Lepas Normal Attack selama Sawring - Blitz Tahap 3 untuk otomatis melancarkan Sawring - Blitz Tahap 3: Falltone, memberikan Havoc DMG.
DMG Sawring - Blitz dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.

Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter

Saat dalam Chainsaw Mode, tekan Normal Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk melancarkan Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter, memberikan Havoc DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack setelah Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter untuk melancarkan Sawring - Blitz Tahap 3.
Tahan Normal Attack saat melancarkan Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter untuk mempertahankan serangan. Saat Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter berakhir, otomatis melancarkan Sawring - Blitz Tahap 3.
Lepas tombol Normal Attack atau Dodge tanpa input arah saat melancarkan Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter untuk otomatis melancarkan Sawring - Blitz Tahap 2: Discordance.
Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter memberikan Resonance Liberation DMG.

Sawring - Eradication

Saat dalam Chainsaw Mode, Chisa melancarkan Sawring - Eradication dengan 2 cara berikut:
- Tekan Normal Attack setelah melancarkan Sawring - Blitz Tahap 3: Falltone.
- Tekan Normal Attack setelah mengonsumsi seluruh Ring of Chainsaw dengan Sawring - Blitz atau Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter.
Menyerang target dengan Sawring - Eradication memberikan Havoc DMG dan memberikan Shield kepada seluruh Resonator di sekitar dalam tim selama 30 dtk.
DMG skill ini dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.
Setiap 1 poin Ring of Chainsaw yang dikonsumsi oleh Sawring - Blitz dan Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter meningkatkan Pengali DMG Sawring - Eradication berikutnya. Hingga 100 poin dihitung untuk efek ini.
Melancarkan skill ini mengonsumsi seluruh Ring of Chainsaw dan mengakhiri Chainsaw Mode.

Chainsaw Fever

Saat dalam Chainsaw Mode, Lifethread - Jetstream diganti dengan Chainsaw Fever.
Chainsaw Fever berada di 100% secara default.
Saat Chisa berlangsung selama beberapa waktu tanpa memberikan damage, Chainsaw Fever akan cepat berkurang. Setelah mencapai 0, Chisa memasuki Burnout State dan keluar dari Chainsaw Mode.
Saat dalam Chainsaw Mode, Chisa mengatur ulang Chainsaw Fever saat memberikan damage atau saat melancarkan Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility, Intro Skill Reverberance - Return, dan Sawring - Blitz Tahap 3: Falltone.
Saat dalam Burnout State, Ring of Chainsaw akan cepat berkurang. Setelah mencapai 0, Chisa keluar dari Burnout State.
Saat dalam Burnout State, Chisa keluar dari kondisi tersebut saat memberikan damage, atau melancarkan Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility dan Intro Skill Reverberance - Return.

Lifethread - Glide

Saat Chisa tidak dalam Chainsaw Mode dan memiliki lebih dari 10 poin Lifethread - Jetstream, ia dapat mengonsumsi 50 poin Lifethread - Jetstream untuk melancarkan Lifethread - Glide dengan 5 cara berikut:
- Tekan Dodge di udara sebelum mendarat setelah melancarkan Heavy Attack.
- Saat di udara, tekan Dodge sebelum mendarat setelah melancarkan Resonance Skill Eye of Unraveling atau Rending Lunge.
- Dodge ke depan sesaat setelah melancarkan Thread Withdrawn.
- Tekan Dodge sebelum mendarat saat terlempar ke udara.
- Tekan Dodge sebelum mendarat setelah melancarkan Lifethread - Glide.
Melancarkan skill ini dapat menarik musuh di sekitar yang ditandai oleh Unseen Snare.
Selama skill, tahan Dodge untuk meluncur sejauh jarak pendek di atas senjata.
Dapat memicu Dodge berhasil dalam jangka waktu tertentu setelah melancarkan skill ini.

Ring of Chainsaw

Chisa dapat menyimpan hingga 100 poin Ring of Chainsaw.
Mengenai target dengan Normal Attack dan Resonance Skill Eye of Unraveling memberikan Ring of Chainsaw.
Melancarkan Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility memberikan 40 poin Ring of Chainsaw.
Melancarkan Intro Skill Reverberance - Return memberikan 20 poin Ring of Chainsaw.

Lifethread - Jetstream

Chisa dapat menyimpan hingga 100 poin Lifethread - Jetstream.
Chisa terus memperoleh Lifethread - Jetstream seiring waktu.
Chisa memperoleh 100 poin Lifethread - Jetstream saat mengalahkan target.
Keluar dari Chainsaw Mode mengatur ulang Lifethread - Jetstream hingga batas maksimal.
Chisa tidak dapat memperoleh Lifethread - Jetstream secara pasif untuk waktu singkat setelah melancarkan Lifethread - Glide.

description.en:
Grant Resonant Thread of Closure to all nearby Resonators in the team for 20s.
While in Resonant Thread of Closure:
- When an attack hits, increase the max stacks of Negative Status and Electro Rage the target can receive by 3 for 15s. Unstackable.
- Inflicting Negative Status or dealing Negative Status DMG grants Thread of Bane for 15s.
description.id:
Memberikan Resonant Thread of Closure kepada seluruh Resonator di sekitar dalam tim selama 20 dtk.
Saat dalam Resonant Thread of Closure:
- Saat serangan mengenai target, tingkatkan batas stack maksimum Negative Status dan Electro Rage yang dapat diterima target sebesar 3 selama 15 dtk. Tidak dapat bertumpuk.
- Memberikan Negative Status atau memberikan DMG Negative Status memberikan Thread of Bane selama 15 dtk.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en:
Chisa is immune to interruption during Sawring - Blitz, Sawring - Eradication, and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter

Inflicting Unseen Snare grants the following additional effects:
- Chisa's ATK is increased by 30% for 15s.
- Deal fixed 61803 points of Havoc DMG. The target's HP can be reduced to 61.80% at most and each target can take this damage only once. This instance of damage is considered Basic Attack DMG that does not bear any effect from damage bonuses.
description.id:
Chisa kebal terhadap interupsi selama Sawring - Blitz, Sawring - Eradication, dan Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter

Memberikan Unseen Snare memberikan efek tambahan berikut:
- ATK Chisa meningkat sebesar 30% selama 15 dtk.
- Memberikan Havoc DMG tetap sebesar 61803 poin. HP target dapat dikurangi hingga 61,80% paling banyak dan setiap target hanya dapat menerima damage ini sekali. Damage ini dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG yang tidak terpengaruh oleh DMG Bonus apa pun.

description.en:
Ignore 10% of the target's Havoc RES when dealing damage.
Nearby Resonators in the team with Thread of Bane gain 50% All-Attribute DMG Bonus.
description.id:
Abaikan 10% Havoc RES target saat memberikan damage.
Resonator di sekitar dalam tim dengan Thread of Bane mendapat 50% DMG Bonus semua Attribute.

The DMG Multipliers of Sawring - Blitz, Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter and Sawring - Eradication are increased by 120%. This effect is mutually stackable with that of Woven Myriad - Convergence.
The bonus DMG Multiplier for Sawring - Eradication granted by Sawring- Blitz and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter when Ring of Chainsaw is consumed is increased by 120%. This effect is mutually stackable with that of Woven Myriad - Convergence.
The Vibration Strength Reduction Rate of Sawring - Blitz, Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter and Sawring - Eradication is increased by 50%.

Bonus Pengali DMG untuk Sawring - Eradication yang diberikan oleh Sawring- Blitz dan Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter saat Ring of Chainsaw dikonsumsi meningkat sebesar 120%. Efek ini dapat bertumpuk dengan efek Woven Myriad - Convergence.
Vibration Strength Reduction Rate Sawring - Blitz, Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter dan Sawring - Eradication meningkat sebesar 50%.

The effect of Unseen Snare becomes:

description.id:

sequences.name: Thousands of Lights to Guide the Way Home

description.en:

Lifethread - Glide costs 50% less Lifethread - Jetstream.
description.id:
Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility mendapat 100% DMG Bonus.
Lifethread - Glide membutuhkan 50% lebih sedikit Lifethread - Jetstream.

sequences.name: Thus, Hope is Rekindled with the Rising Dawn

description.en:
When Chisa takes a fatal blow during Sawring - Blitz, Sawring - Eradication, and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter, she will remain standing with at least 1 HP.

Unseen Snare becomes Unseen Snare - Finality, which has the following effects:
- Unseen Snare - Finality has all the effects of Unseen Snare.
- Targets affected by Unseen Snare - Finality takes 30% Amplified DMG from Negative Statuses.
- Targets affected by Unseen Snare - Finality takes 40% increased DMG from Chisa.
description.id:
Saat Chisa menerima serangan fatal selama Sawring - Blitz, Sawring - Eradication, dan Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter, ia akan tetap berdiri dengan minimal 1 HP.

Unseen Snare menjadi Unseen Snare - Finality, yang memiliki efek berikut:
- Unseen Snare - Finality memiliki seluruh efek Unseen Snare.
- Target yang terkena Unseen Snare - Finality menerima 30% Amplify DMG dari Negative Status.
- Target yang terkena Unseen Snare - Finality menerima 40% lebih banyak DMG dari Chisa.
